original_test_intent: Apply the approved simultaneous input-rail EDP peak profile and prove the installed PSUs/baseboard sustain it without rail collapse, protection trip, reset or component error.
original_method: Pin signed NVQual EDPp module/config; map PSU/feed/rail topology and redundancy/load margin; instrument rail voltage/current/power and system health; approve pulse profile/count/duration and abort/recovery; isolate SUT; run one bounded test; preserve excursions/events/resets and confirm cooldown and final health.
manual_activity: Power/vendor owner provides the rail/PSU envelope and approves destructive-risk peak loading; operator maintains independent cutoff and recovery.
required_inputs: PSU/feed/rail/baseboard map and measured load margin
Independent instrumentation, abort and OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Verify redundancy and facility feed capacity
Abort on droop, protection, reset, thermal or management anomaly
No guessed command or automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Validate artifact, topology, instrumentation, oracle and approval
Collect rail/system telemetry and final health
engineer_actions: Approve power envelope and criteria mapping

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `nvqual edpp` is not authorized by source text and omits pulse, rail and safety semantics.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the pinned vendor EDPp module/config with approved rail instrumentation and interlocks.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All-input-rail worst-case peak intent is retained; missing pulse parameters are not inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate immutable EDPp pulse events with time-aligned per-rail and PSU telemetry plus reset/protection logs.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds measurable power acceptance and interlocked recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Firmware/readability checks do not prove transient PSU capacity.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Peak behavior may require external instruments faster than platform telemetry.

project_override_considerations: Platform power owner defines full/redundant feed configuration and whether every rail is stimulated concurrently.
expected_evidence: Threshold results, recovery/final health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure is a critical all-rail peak-power qualification while Criteria only mention text readability and firmware version.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Vendor and project controls are provisionable; static review is complete while execution awaits them.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row303 Wistron-NV GPU-00296-V003: approve exact NVQual EDPp module/config, all-rail pulse profile, PSU/feed topology and margin, instrumentation, numeric droop/protection/reset limits and recovery; map or replace the unrelated readability/FW Criteria.

review_improvement: Defines observable PSU transient acceptance and independent shutdown instead of treating a high-energy load as a log readout.
independent_technical_reasoning: EDP peaks can be shorter than ordinary BMC sampling and can trip PSU or rail protection. Safe evidence therefore needs a vendor-defined pulse profile and sufficiently fast independent instrumentation; a readable console or correct firmware string says nothing about transient capacity.
